propositions: Batch-path verdicts systematically return confidence=0.0 because the JSON Schema lacks required fields for candidate_id, relation, and confidence, causing the model to omit confidence entries that default below the 0.7 threshold and prevent aggregate from surfacing any findings.
The flat output_token_limit=1024 truncates multi-candidate batches (K≤20 candidates, 10-pair batches with 100+ tokens per entry), causing truncated responses to abstain the entire batch.
Live near-duplicate pairs are never surfaced despite identical artifacts and paraphrased feature descriptions because both root causes interact to block verdict emission.
The per-batch output budget must scale with batch cardinality using the constant _CANDIDATES_PER_CALL and measured per-entry token allowance (256 + 192*n tokens) rather than a flat 1024-token cap.
